result.stdout:
Usage: repolore <command> [options]

Commands:
  version                                    Print CLI and knowledge-format versions.
  path <target> [--include-method]           List durable notes for a source path with status.
  context [<target>] [--session <id>]        Read selected durable and session notes.
            [--node <path>]... [--budget-tokens <n>] [--strict] [--include-method]
  tree [--start <path>]                      List the durable knowledge tree.
  checkpoint                                 Capture the current eligible state.
  history                                    List completed local recovery checkpoints.
  restore <id> [--path <path>] [--dry-run]   Preview or restore a checkpoint within coverage.
  init [--update-method]                     Create the missing knowledge base and first checkpoint.
  migrate [--check | --dry-run]              Migrate alpha knowledge to v1 (check, preview, or apply).
  health-check [--explain <path>] [--session <id>]
                                             Report structural findings; observes only, never fixes.

Common options: --repo-root <path>, --json, --quiet, --help
